findings.title: react and react-dom are 1 major version behind (18 → 19)
findings.detail: package.json pins react and react-dom to ^18.3.1; latest stable is 19.2.7. @types/react and @types/react-dom are also on the v18 type track (18.3.31). No deprecated APIs (forwardRef, ReactDOM.render, Children.*) were found in the source tree, and the project already uses the React 18+ createRoot API, making the upgrade low-risk. Fix was applied on branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-16-react-19 — npm install, npm run build, and npm run test:run (351 tests) all passed — but gh pr create failed: 'Resource not accessible by personal access token (createPullRequest)'. The branch is pushed; a human can open the PR manually.
findings.suggested_fix: Bump react, react-dom, @types/react, and @types/react-dom to ^19 in package.json and run npm install (branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-16-react-19 is ready)

findings.title: All recent CI runs on main show conclusion: skipped
findings.detail: The last 5 runs of the 'Claude Code' workflow on main (most recent: 2026-06-26) all have conclusion='skipped'. This is not a failure, but indicates the workflow may only trigger on PRs or specific conditions and is not running post-merge checks on main.
findings.suggested_fix: Review the 'Claude Code' workflow trigger conditions to ensure it covers push-to-main if desired
